detectors.name: Nitro video skip/countdown overlay
detectors.description: Identifies the isolated Nitro video-ad adapter that renders the timed skip control and pauses/resumes the game during the ad.
detectors.filter_note: Strong signature for the isolated Nitro video interstitial adapter.

detectors.name: Aditude instream adapter
detectors.description: Tracks the Aditude instream-ad adapter, but does not auto-block it because the signature alone does not establish that it owns the timed skip overlay.
detectors.filter_note: Tracked for visibility only; no automatic blocking rule is generated.

detectors.name: CoolMathGames video ad adapter
detectors.description: Tracks the CoolMathGames SDK adapter that requests video ad breaks and pauses/resumes gameplay around the ad.
detectors.filter_note: Tracked for visibility only; the chunk can contain host SDK integration and is not automatically blocked.

detectors.name: AdMob mobile ad adapter
detectors.description: Tracks the mobile AdMob adapter that requests rewarded/interstitial ads and controls mobile banner placements.
detectors.filter_note: Tracked for visibility only; do not block automatically because this is a mobile SDK bridge.

detectors.name: AdInPlay video and banner adapter
detectors.description: Tracks the AdInPlay adapter that loads aiptag, requests pre-roll video ads, and renders banner placements.
detectors.filter_note: Tracked for visibility only; no automatic block rule is generated.
